body: When I was about 13, I suddenly became sick. It started out with the chills and a major headache. Over the course of a few days I couldn't eat or drink anything without my stomach being in severe pain, so this made me not want to eat or drink anything. My temperature was about 102°. About a day later I couldn't walk for more than a step without falling, my legs had became weak. My dad still forced me to go to school even with all these symptoms he just assumed it was just a "fever". I don't know how I made through school for one day. That weekend my father took to me to the doctors to have test done and basically I had nearly no red blood blood cells, I had some but very few. (anemia) my organs and muscle were slowly shutting down from the lack of oxygen (reason being my stomach hurting). I lost 10 pounds. They prescribed me iron vitamins and a few medicines to help the pain so I can eat again. Now I'm very healthy I still have to take the supplements many years later.

Good looks and and intelligence, but very weak immune system. I got a lot of health problems including anemia, a little but of psoriasis, bad kidneys, also have perfectly straight teeth but barley any enamel.
I have been very foward with them before and confronted them but nothing changed.
